subject: Discovery recap + integration/onboarding plan — FastRetail PoC
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@fastretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + integration/onboarding plan — FastRetail PoC

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 40-minute call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off a PoC. Happy to adjust if I missed anything.

Pain points you shared:
- Latency spikes on peak search/checkout pages causing cart abandonment
- Growing cost of third-party GenAI API calls and inconsistent throughput
- Security/compliance constraints: data residency and audit logs required for PCI-adjacent workloads

Current stack and constraints:
- Backend: Node.js services on GCP (us-west1)
- Primary ML infra: internal microservices + edge inference for simple rules
- SDK preference: TypeScript/Node.js first; interested in Python SDK for data science team

Success criteria for PoC (agreed):
1) <20% p95 latency increase vs current baseline while handling typical concurrent traffic (X rps)
2) 30% token cost reduction via batching/prefix cache compared to current provider
3) Demonstrate private VPC deployment option and audit logging for sample requests

Proposed PoC scope & timeline:
- Week 1 (trial setup): Redwood hosted API keys, sample dataset ingestion, integration smoke tests (Ben/Eng)
- Week 2 (integration): SDK integration in staging (TypeScript), validate API compatibility and auth flows (FastRetail devs + Redwood SE)
- Week 3 (validation): Run representative traffic, collect latency/cost metrics, verify KV/prefix caching behavior
- Week 4 (wrap): Review results, present findings, decide on Dedicated or Private deployment next steps

Owners & next meetings:
- Redwood: Ben Carter (AM) — overall PoC owner; Marissa Cole (SE) — integration lead
- FastRetail: Samira Khan — Product Lead; Alex Liu — Lead Engineer

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) I’ll send a PoC MOP (scope + access list) and invite Marissa to the follow-up integration call — action: Ben, by EOD Wed 10/21
2) Samira to confirm staging environment access and a test dataset — action: Samira, by Thu 10/22
3) Exchange security questionnaire artifacts and SSO/KMS details if Private is required — action: Marissa/Naomi/FT security, timeline TBD

Attachments: I’ll share a short PoC MOP and integration matrix in the next email.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — this looks great and captures everything from our call. A couple of clarifications:

- For success criteria #1: our current p95 baseline is ~180ms on search, target would be keeping under 220ms at expected load.
- For cost reduction: the 30% target is compared to our current monthly spend with ProviderX — we’ll share exact numbers in the spreadsheet.
- Security: we will need SOC2 evidence and an outline of access/audit logs for any hosted keys. If Private is required, timeline may extend.

We can provide staging creds and a ~10k-record test set by Thursday EOD. Alex will be the main eng contact for integration.

Next availability: suggested integration call Thurs 10/22 10:00–11:00am PT. If that works for your team, please send calendar invite with dial-in.

Appreciate it — feel free to loop in anyone else from your side.

Best,
Samira
Product Lead, FastRetail
